confidence_notes: Medium overall, uneven by line. Beer, coffee, meal and cocktail anchors come from Koh Samui price guides and listings, some dated 2026, plus a Numbeo snapshot reported by Expatica (1 June 2026). These are crowd-sourced and vary by area (Chaweng vs Lamai) and by happy-hour pricing. Cocktail is set from casual-spot 2026 reports, not from beer. Wine by the glass is the weakest food anchor: no 2026 restaurant glass price was found, so it is set at about twice the beer anchor. Hostel and hotel anchors are model estimates from general knowledge for a July moderate-demand window, not checked against listings. FX is stale: 2026-03-20 is the latest official RBA observation I could confirm, taken from search-result text rather than the live RBA table. A later RBA observation likely exists, so verify before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors reflect Koh Samui local price reports; local THB prices were converted to USD at roughly 33 THB per USD. Wine by the glass is inferred from the beer anchor. Accommodation reflects Koh Samui general knowledge.
